description: Suedew is a Fabric mod that lets server admins simulate command execution as another player, similar to sudo in Linux. Use it to test permissions, trigger commands, or send messages as if you were that player.

mods.name: Suedew
mods.description: Suedew allows server moderators (permission level 2+) to simulate chat or command output as another player for testing, automation, or moderation purposes.
